worldbinder.export.notes.server_import:
WorldBinder Server Import Notes
===============================

This export includes normal root world folders and modern 26.x dimension mirrors.
For Paper/Multiverse imports, use a lowercase world name. The generated server dimension mirror(s): %s

If Paper logs java.nio.file.AccessDeniedException for region files, the files are present but the server process cannot read them.
Stop the server and fix file ownership/permissions before importing again. On Linux this usually means chown/chmod through your panel or host.
A restart alone does not fix wrong ownership.
worldbinder.export.notes.vanilla_export:
WorldBinder Vanilla Export
==========================

Created: %s
Archive: %s
Minecraft: %s
Target output: %s (%s)
Chunks: %s
Blocks: %s
Block entities: %s
Entities: %s

This folder contains a vanilla-shaped save: level.dat, region/*.mca, entities/*.mca where supported, poi/*.mca where supported and resources.zip when available.
Only data actually seen/captured by the client can be exported. Server-hidden data cannot be reconstructed.

worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.accen: Use this accent color for all WorldBinder menus, widgets and the live map.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.custo: Pick any accent color with the color picker. Selecting it switches the theme to Custom.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.backd: How strongly the game behind WorldBinder menus is dimmed. Lower values let more of the world shine through.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.anima: Speed of hover, toggle, page and screen animations. 1.0x is the default feel.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.trans: Soft zoom and fade when menus open and when you switch pages.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.icons: Show pixel icons in navigation, buttons, section headers and cards.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.ui_so: Subtle click, toggle, tab and slider sounds in WorldBinder menus.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.hover: A very quiet tick when the mouse enters a button.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.notif: Short sound when a WorldBinder notification appears (info, success, warning, error).
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.volum: Volume of all WorldBinder interface sounds, relative to your Minecraft volume.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.test_: Plays the success sound with the saved volume.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.display.toolt: Show these info cards when hovering over buttons and fields.
Show keyboard shortcuts and extra hints at the bottom of tooltips.
How long the mouse has to rest on an element before its tooltip appears.
worldbinder.config.discard_hint: You have unsaved changes. Press Cancel or Esc again to discard them.
worldbinder.config.reset_hint: Click again to reset "%s" to its defaults.
worldbinder.config.reset_done: "%s" reset to defaults – Save to keep it.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.reset_tab: Resets every option on this page to its default value. Nothing is stored until you press Save.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.radius: Chunk radius around you that roaming capture keeps scanning (1–12).
worldbinder.tooltip.config.y_min: Lowest Y level that is captured. Lower values capture more caves but take longer.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.y_max: Highest Y level that is captured.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.recovery_inte: Seconds between automatic recovery saves while a capture is running.
worldbinder.tooltip.open_interface: Interface settings: theme, animations, sounds and tooltips.
worldbinder.tooltip.open_movement: Movement tools: 24 helpers, profiles and hotkeys.
worldbinder.tooltip.hint.movement_key: Click the card to toggle • assign a hotkey in Controls
worldbinder.tooltip.hint.movement_bound: Click the card or press %s to toggle
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.hillshade: Shades the live map by terrain height so hills, cliffs and valleys become readable.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.grid: Draws chunk borders when zoomed in and region borders at every zoom level.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.status: Tints queued, scanning, partial and failed chunks on top of the terrain.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.players: Shows other players with their names on the live map.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.sidebar: Shows coverage statistics, cursor info and the chunk inspector next to the map.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.map.smooth: Animated zooming, panning and player following.
worldbinder.config.movement.group.ground: Speed, step, sprint, edge safety, bunny hop, parkour and more.
worldbinder.config.movement.group.vertic: Fly, jetpack, spider climbing, glide, fast ladders and fall protection.
Walk on water, swim faster and float back to the surface.
worldbinder.config.movement.group.contro: Air steering, long jumps, low gravity, elytra boost and jump timing.
worldbinder.config.movement.group.option: Master switch, server safety, movement HUD and hotkeys.
worldbinder.config.movement.profile_appl: Profile "%s" applied – Save to keep it.
worldbinder.config.movement.options.note: Movement tools change your own client movement. Remote servers may forbid or detect them – only use them where it is allowed.
worldbinder.config.movement.options.keys: Every tool has its own toggle key, plus a master key for all tools. They are unbound by default and live in the WorldBinder category of Controls.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.mast: Master switch. When off, all movement tools pause but keep their settings.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.all_: Disables every movement tool in all categories.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.rese: Resets all strength sliders to their default values without changing which tools are on.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.feed: Shows a small banner and plays a sound when a tool is toggled with a hotkey.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.disa: Automatically pauses all movement tools on multiplayer servers and LAN worlds.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.show: Shows active movement tools on the HUD. Position and size are set in the Widget Editor.
Adds the current strength (for example 2.0x) to each movement badge.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.hud_: Detailed shows names and values, Compact shows short tags, Icons only shows small tiles.
worldbinder.tooltip.config.movement.open: Opens Minecraft's Controls to assign toggle keys for single tools or all tools at once.
worldbinder.movement.profile.explorer.to: Faster walking, Step, Auto Sprint, No Fall, Fast Ladder and Auto Surface.
worldbinder.movement.profile.builder.too: Fly, Safe Walk, No Fall, No Slow and faster sneaking.
worldbinder.movement.profile.parkour.too: Auto Sprint, Parkour edge jumps, Long Jump, Air Control and No Jump Delay.
worldbinder.movement.profile.aquatic.too: Jesus, Water Speed and Auto Surface.
worldbinder.movement.profile.sky.tooltip: Elytra Boost, Glide, Low Gravity, Jetpack and No Fall.
worldbinder.movement.bunny_hop.tooltip: Hops automatically while moving forward on the ground and keeps a little extra speed on every hop.
worldbinder.movement.long_jump.tooltip: Sprint jumps travel further (1.0–4.0x). Horizontal speed is capped for stability.
worldbinder.movement.sneak_speed.tooltip: Move faster while sneaking (1.0–3.0x). Edges stay safe like normal sneaking.
worldbinder.movement.no_slow.tooltip: Walk through soul sand, honey and other slowing blocks at full speed.
worldbinder.movement.parkour.tooltip: Jumps automatically at the last moment when you run off a block edge.
worldbinder.movement.no_jump_delay.toolt: Removes the short cooldown between jumps while holding Jump.
worldbinder.movement.jetpack.tooltip: Hold Jump in the air for smooth upward thrust (1.0–5.0x). Release to fall normally.
worldbinder.movement.low_gravity.tooltip: Reduces your gravity from 100% down to 10% for floaty jumps and slow falls.
worldbinder.movement.elytra_boost.toolti: Hold Forward while gliding to accelerate in your look direction (1.0–5.0x).
worldbinder.movement.auto_surface.toolti: Floats you back up in water automatically. Sneak or sprint-swim to dive.
worldbinder.map.cursor_hint: Move the mouse over the map to see block coordinates, height and chunk status.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.layers: Choose what the map shows: terrain, capture status, relief shading, grid and players.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.sidebar: Show or hide the info sidebar.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.zoom_in: Zoom in towards the map center. The mouse wheel zooms towards the cursor.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.zoom_out: Zoom out from the map center.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.go_field: Enter block coordinates as "X Z" or "X Y Z" and press Enter.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.copy: Copies the selected chunk center as "X Y Z" to the clipboard.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.center: Moves the camera to the selected chunk.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.click_hint: Click: select • Double-click: center • Right-click: rescan
worldbinder.capture_setup.subtitle: Everything your client receives around you is saved into a new archive.
worldbinder.capture_setup.use_world_name: Use the current world or server name as archive name.
worldbinder.capture_setup.reset_name.too: Restore the default archive name from the settings.
worldbinder.capture_setup.name_cleaned: Special characters and capitals are adjusted for the folder name.
worldbinder.capture_setup.preset.tooltip: Click to cycle Safe, Balanced, Fast and Extreme.
worldbinder.version_picker.subtitle_rich: Current target: %s (%s) • choose which Minecraft version your export is written for
worldbinder.version_picker.search_hint: Search version, update name or year…
worldbinder.version_picker.chip_tooltip:
Minecraft %s
%s (%s). Click to use this version as export target.
worldbinder.version_picker.footer_hint: Hover a version for details • click to use it
worldbinder.version_picker.use_latest.to: Export for the newest supported version (same as your game).
worldbinder.version_picker.downgrade_hin: Blocks, items and entities that do not exist in %s are converted to the closest equivalent or left out. Check the validation report after exporting.
worldbinder.version_family.aquatic.descr: Oceans, shipwrecks, coral reefs, dolphins and the 1.13 flattening of block IDs.
worldbinder.version_family.village.descr: New villages, pillagers, raids, job blocks and many new building blocks.
worldbinder.version_family.bees.descript: Bees, beehives, honey and honeycomb blocks.
worldbinder.version_family.nether.descri: New Nether biomes, netherite, piglins and bastions; the end of the old chunk palette packing.
worldbinder.version_family.caves_one.des: Copper, amethyst, goats and axolotls. Entities move into their own region files.
worldbinder.version_family.caves_two.des: Taller world from -64 to 320, new caves and mountains. A major chunk format change.
worldbinder.version_family.wild.descript: Deep dark, ancient cities, mangroves, frogs and the warden.
worldbinder.version_family.trails.descri: Cherry groves, archaeology, sniffers and camels. 1.20.5 introduces item components.
worldbinder.version_family.trials.descri: Trial chambers, the breeze, the mace and crafter.
worldbinder.version_family.bundles.descr: Game drop with bundles in every color and many smaller improvements.
worldbinder.version_family.garden.descri: Game drop with the pale garden, the creaking and resin.
worldbinder.version_family.spring.descri: Game drop with new animal variants, ambient sounds and leaf litter.
worldbinder.version_family.skies.descrip: Game drop with the happy ghast and dried ghast blocks.
worldbinder.version_family.drops_2026.de: The 26.x releases with the new version numbering. 26.3 matches your game and is written natively.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.explore:
Explore mode
Adds every chunk your client has loaded to the map – without capturing or saving blocks. Great for overview maps and exports.
worldbinder.map.explore_on: Explore mode on – loaded chunks appear on the map
worldbinder.map.empty_hint_explore: Start a capture with F6, or turn on Explore in the toolbar to map every loaded chunk without capturing.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.export: Export the map as PNG image or as region tiles.
worldbinder.map.export.full.tooltip: One image of the whole known area, 1 pixel per block (downscaled above 8192 px).
worldbinder.map.export.tiles.tooltip: 256×256 tiles named r.<x>.<z>.png – ideal for web map viewers.
worldbinder.map.export.status.tooltip: Tint queued, scanning, partial and failed chunks in the exported image.
worldbinder.map.export.failed: Map export failed – see log for details
worldbinder.map.export.empty: Nothing to export yet – capture or explore first
worldbinder.map.tooltip.limit: Stops panning far away from known chunks.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.marker: Show these entities as markers on the map and radar (only entities your client can see).
worldbinder.map.filter.progress.tooltip: Queued, scanning, partial or recovering chunks.
worldbinder.map.filter.failed.tooltip: Chunks with capture or export errors.
worldbinder.map.filter.entities.tooltip: Chunks with at least one captured entity.
worldbinder.map.filter.block_entities.to: Chunks with chests, signs, spawners and other block entities.
worldbinder.map.filter.low_quality.toolt: Chunks with a capture quality below 55%.
worldbinder.map.filter.recent.tooltip: Chunks scanned within the last two minutes.
worldbinder.map.filter.explored_only.too: Chunks seen in explore mode but not captured yet.
worldbinder.map.filter.invert.tooltip: Highlight everything that does NOT match.
worldbinder.map.filter.hide.tooltip: Hide non-matching chunks completely instead of dimming them.
worldbinder.tooltip.widget_editor.snap: Snap widgets to screen edges, the center and other widgets. Hold Shift to place freely.
worldbinder.tooltip.widget_editor.previe: Hide the editor and see the HUD exactly as in game. Click or press H/Esc to return.
worldbinder.widget_editor.preview_hint: Preview • click or press H to return to the editor
worldbinder.tooltip.widget_editor.use_th: Set the widget accent to the current interface theme color.
worldbinder.tooltip.widget_editor.apply_: Copy accent and background of this widget to every widget.
worldbinder.widget_editor.keys_hint: Arrows move 1 px (Shift 10) • Ctrl+Tab next widget • Del show/hide • Ctrl+Z undo
worldbinder.widget_editor.status_extra: The status bar has no extra options. Change its look on the Style page.
worldbinder.widget_editor.radar_rotate.t: Rotate the radar so your view direction always points up.
worldbinder.widget_editor.radar_entities: Show players and the entity marker types enabled on the live map.
worldbinder.widget_editor.radar_coords.t: Show your position and facing below the radar.
worldbinder.widget_editor.radar_always.t: Keep the radar visible as a minimap even when no capture is running.
Adds the current strength (for example 2.0x) to each movement badge.
worldbinder.config.display.notification_: Short sound when a WorldBinder notification appears.
worldbinder.map.tooltip.view3d:
3D view
Shows the known terrain as a rotatable 3D landscape. Right-drag rotates and tilts, left-drag moves, the wheel zooms.
worldbinder.map.3d.on: 3D view on – right-drag to rotate and tilt
worldbinder.map.3d.tilt_down.tooltip: Tilt the camera towards the horizon.
worldbinder.map.3d.tilt_up.tooltip: Tilt the camera towards a top-down view.
worldbinder.map.3d.height.tooltip: Height exaggeration of the terrain (now %s%%). Click to cycle 50 – 300%%.
worldbinder.map.3d.reset.tooltip: Reset rotation, tilt and height scale.
worldbinder.map.layer.block_colors.toolt:
Map block colors
Auto: vanilla map colors, but blocks changed by resource packs (e.g. custom server blocks via note block states) use their real texture color.
Vanilla: only the vanilla map palette.
Textures: every block uses its texture color.
worldbinder.map.block_colors_set: Map colors: %s – explored chunks are redrawn, new captures use the new colors
worldbinder.map.layer.waypoints.tooltip: Shows your map waypoints and the last death point. P or Shift+right click places a waypoint, right click on a waypoint removes it.
worldbinder.map.export.model.tooltip: Exports the known surface as a colored 3D block model: map_3d.glb (Blender, Windows 3D Viewer, web viewers) and, for smaller areas, map_3d.obj. Large areas are merged into bigger cells.
worldbinder.map.export.render.tooltip: Saves the current 3D view in high resolution with a transparent background. Uses the rotation, tilt and height scale of the 3D view.
worldbinder.tooltip.reexport: Builds a new save folder from the archive stored in this export, using the current exporter. Use this to repair worlds exported with WorldBinder 1.6.0–1.6.2 for Minecraft 26.3 (blocks missing, resource pack missing, experimental warning). The original folder is kept.
worldbinder.chat.reexport_failed: Exporting the archive again failed. See the log for details.
worldbinder.map.layer.invisible.tooltip: Shows barriers, light blocks and structure voids on the 2D map, the radar and in 3D (red, yellow and purple). They are invisible in game, so they are hidden by default and the map shows the terrain below them. Captured chunks show the change after the next scan.
